visual_logic.surface_detail: Rugged, battle-scarred 'Slate Grey' skin. Strong, visible musculature along the horizontal flank and paddle limbs is emphasized to highlight raw power over speed.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side profile view displaying the full horizontal length of the marine reptile. Hero focus is placed on the 'Apex Predator' jaw lined with massive, robust teeth and the extraordinarily large eye (25cm diameter) facing laterally.
visual_logic.environment: Turbulent Early Jurassic coastal waters with kicked-up silt and 'Pyrite Gold' mineral glints shifting horizontally through the background water columns.
visual_logic.pose: The massive ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right across the card layout. Its jaws are wide open parallel to the frame, and its massive lateral eye is focused intently forward to cleanly match the tracking mechanics of the central measuring tape layout.
